instruction: Visit the community forums and select the discussion thread that has received the greatest number of user replies.

metadata.explanation: Final variation asking user to visit forums and select the most-replied discussion. Evaluator validates correct navigation to the expected URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Instruction requires selecting the thread with 'greatest number of user replies' (dynamic, comparative requirement)
Evaluator only checks if a specific hardcoded URL is active (static, absolute check)
No logic to verify the thread actually has the most replies compared to other threads
No logic to extract or compare reply counts across threads
Expected URL is hardcoded without evidence it's actually the thread with most replies
Semantic mismatch: instruction asks for dynamic property (max replies) but evaluator checks static value (specific URL)
If reply counts change over time, a different thread might have most replies, but evaluator will still only pass for this hardcoded URL
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Use get_info_from_website to navigate to forums and extract reply counts for all threads
Add custom getter to scrape thread list with reply counts using CSS selectors
Add custom metric to find thread with maximum reply count and compare its URL to actual active tab
Update expected value to include reply count verification, not just URL matching
Alternative: Change instruction to 'Navigate to The Banter Thread discussion' to match static URL check
If keeping current instruction, evaluator must dynamically determine which thread has most replies at runtime
